record.original_question: For the new asymptotically conical (AC) G2-manifolds constructed by Foscolo, Haskins, and Nordstrom that are cohomogeneity-1 under an SU(2) x SU(2) x U(1) action, which of the locally defined G2-instantons near the singular orbit extend to globally defined G2-instantons on the whole manifold X, and, once the global solutions are classified and a nontrivial family is found, what global properties does the resulting moduli space have? In particular, what happens for the D7 family from [FHN18]?

evidence.quote: Recently, infinitely many new examples of AC G2-manifolds X have been found [FHN18]. These examples are cohomogeneity-1 for an action of SU(2) x SU(2) x U(1) and so the theory of G2-instantons with these symmetries developed in [LO18] applies. Therefore, the local existence of G2-instantons near the singular orbit in X is guaranteed, and the open question is how many of these local solutions extend globally on X. Once one has classified the global solutions and has a non-trivial family, one can then ask about global properties of the moduli space of solutions, such as those discussed above. This would be specially interesting for the family D7 of [FHN18], as this was not considered in [LO18].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the family of asymptotically conical (AC) 7-dimensional Riemannian manifolds $(X,g)$ with holonomy contained in the exceptional Lie group $G_2$ that arise as cohomogeneity-one manifolds for an isometric action of $SU(2)\times SU(2)\times U(1)$ with a single singular orbit. (Here a complete Riemannian $G_2$-manifold $(X,g)$ is asymptotically conical if outside a compact set it is diffeomorphic to a cone $C(\Sigma)=(R_0,\infty)\times\Sigma$ over a smooth compact 6-manifold $\Sigma$, with the metric $g$ converging at a polynomial rate to the conical metric $dr^2+r^2 g_\Sigma$ where $g_\Sigma$ is a nearly Kähler metric on $\Sigma$.) Among the families of such metrics constructed via cohomogeneity-one methods, distinguish in particular the family denoted $D_7$.

A $G_2$-instanton on $X$ is a connection $A$ on a principal $G$-bundle $P\to X$ (for $G$ a compact Lie group, e.g. $SU(2)$) whose curvature $F_A\in\Omega^2(X;\mathrm{ad}\,P)$ satisfies $F_A\wedge\psi=0$, where $\psi=*\varphi$ is the Hodge dual of the defining $G_2$ 3-form $\varphi$ on $X$. An $SU(2)\times SU(2)\times U(1)$-invariant $G_2$-instanton is one for which the action lifts to $P$ and preserves $A$.

Local existence of invariant $G_2$-instantons in a neighborhood of the singular orbit is known; equivariantly, near the singular orbit the equations reduce to an ODE system whose solutions are parameterized by a finite-dimensional moduli of initial data compatible with the isotropy representation.

Problems:
(a) For each of these AC $G_2$-manifolds $X$ (and especially for the $D_7$ family), determine which of the locally defined $SU(2)\times SU(2)\times U(1)$-invariant $G_2$-instantons defined in a neighborhood of the singular orbit extend to globally defined smooth $G_2$-instantons on all of $X$ with finite Yang–Mills energy and an appropriate decay rate at infinity.
(b) Classify all such global invariant $G_2$-instantons, and, when a nontrivial family exists, describe the global properties of the resulting moduli space (dimension, smoothness, compactness, behavior at the boundary corresponding to bubbling or to limits along the asymptotic cone).
artifact.status_search_result: For some of the cohomogeneity-one AC/ALC $G_2$-manifolds in the FHN family, invariant $G_2$-instantons have been constructed: in particular for the $B_7$ and $C_7$ families (work by Matos, Lotay–Oliveira, and others) one-parameter families of $SU(2)^2$- or $SU(2)^2\times U(1)$-invariant $G_2$-instantons are known. The $D_7$ case, explicitly singled out in the original problem, does not appear to have been treated in the available literature, and the global structure of the moduli space (compactification, bubbling) remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: G2-instantons on the ALC members of the B7 family
status_evidence.snippet: A two-parameter family of non-abelian G2-instantons is constructed on every member of the ALC B7-family of G2-metrics on S^3 × R^4 using cohomogeneity-one symmetries.
status_evidence.claim: Invariant G2-instantons have been constructed on the B7 family.

status_evidence.title: SU(2)^2-Invariant Gauge Theory on Asymptotically Conical Calabi–Yau 3-Folds
status_evidence.snippet: SU(2)^2×U(1)-invariant G2-instantons on the asymptotically conical limit of the C7 family of G2-metrics have been constructed via a dynamical systems approach.
status_evidence.claim: Invariant instantons constructed for the C7 family AC limit.

status_evidence.title: G2-Instantons on the Spinor Bundle of the 3-Sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Classification of G2-instantons admitting SU(2)^3-symmetries on the Bryant–Salamon AC G2-metric on the spinor bundle of S^3.
status_evidence.claim: Related classification results on a Bryant–Salamon AC G2-manifold are known.
